description: Obtaining buildings' base case and electrified hourly energy consumption using building energy analysis with EnergyPlus and OpenStudio is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Ali Khosravani, Matthew DeHaan (University of Utah). Data sets used in Khosravani et al., 2024 - Electrification of residential and commercial buildings integrated with hybrid renewable energy systems: A techno-economic analysis. (For citation: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.energy.2024.131893) Using building energy analysis, we obtained the base case hourly electricity and natural gas loads and the hourly electrified load. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
